round>=3 cannot submit through live controls: completion clears/destroys them and callback guards round/dead.

guard_reachability.persistent_secondary: Every slider onInput calls draw; archive-feedback has three literal branches. Ready is not a rejection but included to satisfy the complete secondary owner domain.
guard_reachability.excluded_unrelated_owner: archive-round has three fixed stage instructions, not refusal feedback; original reports retained. Shared pause/blurb strings are outside module error-longest.
